title: Agent Baseline Check v0.1 Candidate
title_zh: 智能体评估基线检查器 v0.1 候选
purpose: Describe a deterministic claim-scoped compatibility candidate that could identify which prior evaluation conclusions require reassessment after a bounded configuration change.

candidate_outputs.VALID: Every dependency declared by the claim is present, comparable and unchanged. This means only that the prior evaluation remains applicable to the declared scope.
candidate_outputs.STALE: At least one dependency declared by the claim changed. The prior conclusion must not be inherited without reassessment.
candidate_outputs.UNKNOWN: At least one required dependency value or comparison is missing, ambiguous or not comparable. The checker must fail closed without guessing.

claim_dependency_rule: Only a changed dimension that the individual claim explicitly depends on can make that claim STALE. Unrelated claims remain VALID only when all of their own declared dependencies are known and unchanged.

current_state.runtime: watsonx Orchestrate Agent Lab or Builder

limits: The official change record establishes the migration date and replacement offering; no IBM tenant or migrated Agent was inspected.
The fixture does not claim that every evaluation changes in the same way.
A new Draft alone does not change the approved effective revision returned by Search or the Registry MCP endpoint.
The fixture does not call AWS or assert that the namespace migration is complete.
The fixture consumes tools/list and notifications/tools/list_changed semantics; it does not implement an MCP scanner, client or server.
VALID is prohibited when the prompt digest required by the unrelated claim is missing or incomparable.

overlaps.verified_overlap: Visualizes related governance objects and helps identify possible downstream impact after an asset changes.
overlaps.unverified_gap: No inspected official page established deterministic per-claim VALID, STALE or UNKNOWN evaluation inheritance.

overlaps.verified_overlap: Creates and replays recorded Agent baselines to detect behavioral deviations.
overlaps.unverified_gap: No inspected official page established cross-framework dependency selection that avoids unrelated evaluation reruns.

overlaps.verified_overlap: Track versions, evaluation runs, datasets and regressions across application changes.
overlaps.unverified_gap: No inspected official page established deterministic claim-scoped invalidation over all five candidate dimensions.

overlaps.verified_overlap: Provides runtime policy, identity, sandbox, audit and SRE governance surfaces.
overlaps.unverified_gap: Its published limitations do not establish historical evaluation inheritance after dependency changes.

overlaps.verified_overlap: Defines event-triggered evidence freshness and marks an evaluation run stale after model, prompt, tool-manifest or retrieval-corpus change.
overlaps.unverified_gap: The inspected publication is guidance, not a verified cross-framework claim-dependency checker; its rule is broader than selective claim-scoped invalidation.

targeted_adopt_before_build_audit.stop_build_condition: Stop the candidate if a maintained, deterministic and cross-framework tool is verified to bind individual claims to the five dimensions and produce equivalent fail-closed selective invalidation.

reasons_retained: The advisor preferred composing IBM governance relationships with Registry, evaluation and telemetry products.
The advisor identified the D16 development freeze as a blocking condition.
The advisor assumed that useful output requires automatic external retest execution.
corrections: The complete-equivalent claim remains NOT_PROVEN because the inspected primary sources establish component capabilities, not the end-to-end claim-scoped state machine.
The candidate boundary does not require executing tests or invoking external systems; it would only route reassessment.
The D16 freeze remains decisive, so implementation is deferred even though the narrow gap was not eliminated.

implementation_decision.next_decision_required: After the D16 mainline freeze is lifted, re-run the adopt-before-build audit and obtain a separate SAEE implementation decision before any behavior or capability change.
